response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, account_count * 1.0 / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10
